searchText: <@!203220829473996800> PR sent. https://github.com/protolambda/mergenet-tutorial/pull/19 It feels like that there should be a general "testnet controller" project in which you can -- completely dockerized -- bring up as many as diverse clients as you want and have them talk to each other. Maybe add a load generator, and some monitoring tools like forkmon. Does such a project exist for ETH2? <@381414973747757059> there's this: https://github.com/eth2-clients/multinet But it would break too often due to client changes pre-launch. Maybe now it wouldn't. Agree that something like it would be nice. For the merge, I think we can turn the tutorial repo into something like it. <@!203220829473996800> Thank you, that looks promising. I'll play around with it! 🙂 I'll also shutdown our nodes too 🙂
